subject: general
question: Which of the following information is necessary to construct a rectangle?

options.text: Length of one side and the area of the rectangle
Only the length of the diagonal
Only the length of one side

solution:
The correct answer is __Length of two adjacent sides__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• To construct a rectangle, the length of two adjacent sides is sufficient.
 
• A rectangle is a quadrilateral with four right angles.
 
• The dimensions of a rectangle are defined by the lengths of its two adjacent sides.
 
• Once the lengths of adjacent sides are known, the opposite sides are equal in length, ensuring the rectangle's shape.
 
• The diagonal can be calculated using the Pythagorean theorem if needed.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Area of a Rectangle:**

 
 
• The area is given by the product of its length and breadth.
 
• Knowing only the area and one side does not provide enough information to construct the rectangle.
 
 
 
• **Diagonal of a Rectangle:**
 
 
• The diagonal is calculated using the formula √(length² + breadth²).
 
• Knowing only the diagonal does not provide sufficient information to construct the rectangle.
